en: The Apadāna of the Elder Kadambapupphiya Mandāravapupphiya Chapter, Number 6 I offered a kadamba flower to the Buddha Vipassī, who was seated upon his seat of enlightenment. Because of that root of merit, I have never been born in the lower realms. For eighty-four thousand aeons I dwelt in heaven; for eighty-four thousand aeons I dwelt among humans. Having passed away from there, I was reborn in this world. I am now an arahant, free from all taints. My final body has been attained, and I shall not be born again. This is my last birth. I saw the Leader of the World seated in that sublime palace.
Since I made offerings to the Buddha,
I have not known a miserable rebirth;
this is the fruit of offering to the Buddha.
[and so on] ...the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed the venerable elder Kadambapupphiya spoke these verses.
This is the sixth legend of the elder Kadambapupphiya.
